_comment: TD12: S3 heavy at 55 m again with no noise repeats, so every run measures the same stretch of the stress timeline (its first 3 to 23 s after each rebuild). In the full sweep the repeats of a noisy run fell later in the timeline, where heavy load at 55 m drew about half the particles (19k against 8 to 10k), and the search took the median attempt, so that point's 1,017 measured a lighter load. Other points held their load across attempts.
